beats.label: THE FIX
beats.note: Put a name next to every step.

copy.caption: A made-up story: Fatima's group project is due and everyone thought someone else had it. The fix: put a name next to every step. Names on steps turn “someone” into “me.” Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens (30 short sessions, 6 skills): link in bio.
